query: colorectal surgery surgical site infection care bundle compliance individual elements prospective
sourcesConsulted: model knowledge of surgical infection literature
synthesis: Three further reports are suggested as leads to search for alongside the seven retrieved records: a regional bundle collaborative, a report on triclosan-coated sutures and a study of wound dressings after stoma formation. None has been retrieved or checked.

items.title: A regional collaborative to raise colorectal bundle compliance across nine hospitals
items.keyFindings: Monthly feedback of element-level compliance raised full compliance from about a third to over half.
items.notes: Lead; the year was not given as a number.

items.title: Antibacterial-coated sutures for abdominal wall closure after colorectal surgery
items.keyFindings: Coated sutures were associated with fewer superficial infections.

items.title: Wound dressings after stoma formation and infection of the midline wound
items.keyFindings: Midline infections were more frequent when the stoma was sited close to the wound.

summary: Three leads added; one lead's year was not a number.
